lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regular arrangement of circular high-luminance pixel clusters forming a staggered grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a structured grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Strong horizontal linear feature along the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high (dorsal) to low (ventral).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe traumatic amputation of the primary dorsal fin with visible jagged margins. A secondary major excavation of tissue is present on the dorsal midline posterior to the primary injury site.
